options.name: Battlecry
options.benefit: Inspire allies within 100 feet with a morale bonus on attacks, skills, and saves.

options.name: Battlefield Clarity
options.benefit: Reroll a failed save against debilitating battlefield conditions with an insight bonus.

options.name: Combat Healer
options.benefit: Spend two spell slots to cast a cure spell as a swift action.

options.name: Iron Skin
options.benefit: Harden your skin as stoneskin to gain DR 10/adamantine.

options.name: Maneuver Mastery
options.benefit: Use oracle level as BAB for one combat maneuver and gain its Improved and Greater feats as you advance.

options.name: Resiliency
options.benefit: Remain effective at 0 hit points and gain Diehard at 7th level.

options.name: Skill at Arms
options.benefit: Gain proficiency with all martial weapons and heavy armor.

options.name: Surprising Charge
options.benefit: Move up to your speed as an immediate action a limited number of times per day.

options.name: War Sight
options.benefit: Roll initiative multiple times and gain increasing control over surprise rounds.

options.name: Weapon Mastery
options.benefit: Gain Weapon Focus, Improved Critical, and Greater Weapon Focus with one proficient weapon as you advance.

options.name: Armor of Bones
options.benefit: Conjure scaling bone armor that eventually grants DR 5/bludgeoning.

options.name: Bleeding Wounds
options.benefit: Negative-energy damage from your spells causes scaling bleed damage.

options.name: Death's Touch
options.benefit: Make a limited-use negative-energy touch that harms living creatures and heals undead.

options.name: Near Death
options.benefit: Gain scaling insight bonuses against disease, poison, mental effects, death, sleep, and stunning.

options.name: Raise the Dead
options.benefit: Temporarily summon a scaling skeleton or zombie servant.

options.name: Resist Life
options.benefit: Interact with positive and negative energy as undead and gain scaling channel resistance.

options.name: Soul Siphon
options.benefit: Bestow a temporary negative level with a ray and heal yourself.

options.name: Spirit Walk
options.benefit: Become incorporeal and invisible while moving through obstacles.

options.name: Undead Servitude
options.benefit: Gain Command Undead and channel negative energy solely to command undead.

options.name: Voice of the Grave
options.benefit: Speak with dead for scaling rounds each day and weaken resistance as you advance.
